SPY.note: Instrument and switches come from rules.json (active, spy_options_enabled, shares_enabled).

note: focus = symbols evaluated each run, in priority order. Adding a symbol here only WATCHES it. A symbol other than SPY or SNDK trades only with "trading_enabled": true and "instrument": "options" or "shares" on its entry. The console can change focus and add symbols; it cannot switch trading on.
